hotels.title: Idyllic Southern Sri Lanka Clifftop Weligama Escape near Galle Fort with Iconic Crescent-Shaped Pool
hotels.description: Fall in love with the picturesque southern coast of Sri Lanka from this gorgeous five-star retreat, perched on the edge of soaring cliffs and overlooking the rolling waves of the Indian Ocean. A member of the prestigious Relais & Chateaux collection, this boutique haven boasts suites and villas with terracotta-tiled roofs, recreating a traditional Sri Lankan village. Savour every inch of the ocean from the crescent-shaped infinity pool, at the Beach Club or from three elevated lookouts and indulge in restorative treatments in the comfort of your room or at the Sanctuary Spa. For the gourmands, culinary delight awaits with three restaurants, offering everything from traditional Sri Lankan curries to 'chef's table' style dining.

hotels.title: Sri Lanka Oceanfront Luxury on Weligama Bay with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Massages
hotels.description: Few stays showcase Sri Lanka's world-class surf, year-round sunshine and powder-fine sands like Weligama Bay Marriott Resort & Spa, set on the shore of Weligama's iconic bay. Here, ocean views stretch out before every window and balcony - the beach begins where the resort ends. Protected from big swells, with consistent waves, this is the island's go-to spot for surfers of every level. The onsite dining venues cover every mood: Weligama Kitchen brings Sri Lankan and international buffet with ocean views; Big Fish puts the island's exceptional seafood front and centre; the Mirissa Baking Company handles mornings with coffee and fresh pastries; and Surf's Up Pool & Beach Bar keeps afternoons flowing by the water. Three pools, including a kids' pool with waterslide, cascade toward the shoreline, while Quan Spa offers treatments designed to slow everything down.
